scene: Inside the glowing gazebo, fragrant steam swirls around three outbound boarding portals.
picture: A flat side view inside the octagonal tea gazebo. On the far left, a low door opens onto a lantern-lit river barge. The player stands left-centre beside a brass turnstile leading to a glass-roofed trolley at centre. On the far right, a spiral lift cage sits open, waiting beside steaming tea samovars.
shown: a low wooden canal door leading to a lantern-lit barge on the far left
a brass turnstile before a waiting glass-roofed trolley at the centre
a round open cage lift with spiraling copper tracks on the far right
